jet.notes: `jet build main.jet` infers the Web target from `#Target(Web)` and produces `build/app.js` plus `build/app.wasm`; `node runner.mjs` replays the real generated DOM path and matches expected.out. The package declares broad authority so native `jet run main.jet` launches; it exits 0 with empty stdout. Jet interaction-replay mechanism is not reachable from the shipped `jet` CLI; the web AOT build plus `node runner.mjs` is the closest CLI-reachable proof.
